risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (350+), flat yield curve, imminent NFP event, and 55-day earnings window create severely adverse macro conditions for DTE trading.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term EMA alignment (50/200 bullish), Ichimoku cross-up, and supertrend bullish structure with price near support (114.75) offer technical setup foundation in extreme fear environment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Weak trend strength (ADX 21.1), overbought stochastics, price below 9-EMA, low volume (0.38 ratio), Bollinger Band squeeze, zero fundamental support, and crisis-level macro conditions (VIX 350+, earnings in 55 days) create compounding entry risk.
